episode_id: Migrate my settings to the current key names. Rename the old key in the project's settings and keep its value./seed-0-config_renamed-29016

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'drop_old', which accepts ['drop_old'], but the program implements 'rename'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.body:
set -euo pipefail
mapfile -t tracked < <(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n')
renames_file=""
for f in "${tracked[@]}"; do
  case "$f" in
    *renames*) renames_file="$f"; break;;
  esac
done
if [ -z "$renames_file" ]; then
  for f in "${tracked[@]}"; do
    if grep -qE '^#[[:space:]]*keys the app has renamed' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      renames_file="$f"
      break
    fi
  done
fi
test -n "$renames_file"
sed_args=()
n=0
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  case "$line" in
    ''|\#*) continue;;
  esac
  case "$line" in
    *=*) ;;
    *) continue;;
  esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  if [ -z "$old" ] || [ -z "$new" ]; then continue; fi
  sed_args+=(-e "s/^${old}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*/${new} = /")
  n=$((n + 1))
done < "$renames_file"
if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
fi
for f in "${tracked[@]}"; do
  if [ "$f" = "$renames_file" ]; then continue; fi
  if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then continue; fi
  sed -i "${sed_args[@]}" "$f"
done
git add -A
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "Migrate settings to current key names"
fi
exit 0
refused_program.intent: Rename stale setting keys to their current names using the project's rename map, preserving each value, then commit the migration.

postconditions.description: every renamed key now appears under its new name with the value it had before the migration commit
postconditions.name: new_key_keeps_value
postconditions.probe:
rf=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -i 'renames' | head -n1)
[ -n "$rf" ] || exit 1
found=0
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  case "$line" in
    ''|\#*) continue;;
  esac
  case "$line" in
    *=*) ;;
    *) continue;;
  esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  if [ -z "$old" ] || [ -z "$new" ]; then continue; fi
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ "$f" = "$rf" ] && continue
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    prev=$(git show "HEAD~1:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^${old}[[:space:]]*=" | head -n1)
    [ -n "$prev" ] || continue
    val=$(printf '%s' "$prev" | sed -E "s/^${old}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//")

      found=1

      exit 1
    fi
  done < <(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n')
done < "$rf"
[ "$found" -eq 1 ]
